newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: Abidjan blue-chip index rises again.
newsitem.headline: Abidjan blue-chip index rises again.

text.p: The Abidjan Stock Exchange's blue chip index shot up once again in the week to Friday, taking its rise in value in 1997 to 24.80 percent, the market report showed.
The 12-VB blue-chip index rose 2.08 percent to 302.01 points after rising 2.48 percent in the previous week.
Once again tobacco company SITAB, up 3,450 CFA at 52,500 CFA, and bank BICICI, up 2,090 at 43,040, were among the main risers.
The All-Share Index rose 1.68 percent to 427.91, taking the rise on the year to 19.60 percent. The All-Share index rose 0.46 percent in the previous week.
Other risers this week were textile company UNIWAX, up 3,340 at 77,000, food company NESTLE, up 3,110 to 64,360, and car dealers SARI, 2,250 higher at 26,250.
The main loser was cement company SOCIMAT, down 1,620 at 39,680. Trading company PEYRISSAC lost 500 to 35,500 after paying a 1,250 CFA dividend.
A total of 5,664 shares worth 174,070,010 CFA francs changed hands up on the 3,011 shares worth 76,649,440 CFA in the previous week.
